name: vibe-glow
description: Repeatable multi-stage UI beautification campaigns for any app. Four gated stages as slash commands — identity (invent the design language, stress-tested against user theming), audit (five Opus review lenses plus a skeptic pass that refutes findings before they become work), wave (findings-driven fix batches with re-capture and re-review until surfaces measure clean), reveal (the flagship release). Evidence adapters for WinUI (PowerShell window capture) and web (Playwright). State-aware router; per-repo campaign state committed alongside the code. Minimal first cut — evolve machinery arrives after the dogfood run earns it.
